run_note: The pair_02_mid_equatorial raw products (OHRC ch2_ohr_ncp_20250612T2229094979_d_img_d18 and LROC M1504316436RC) are stored on D:\SIH, which was not mounted during this session. The EXP-005 runner (scripts/run_exp005.py) requires those products. The metrics below are sourced from the EXP-001 SIFT arm record (experiments/EXP-001/results/pair_02_mid_equatorial.json), which ran the identical frozen pipeline including zncc_parabolic_baseline refinement. When D:\SIH is remounted, run: $env:CHANDRAYAN_DATA_ROOT = 'D:\SIH'; python scripts/run_exp005.py to populate a live record.
hypothesis: H1: On pair_02_mid_equatorial, with the EXP-001 SIFT configuration held fixed, the existing ZNCC + parabolic refinement produces measurable coordinate changes relative to identity passthrough and those changes strictly reduce held-out image-space transfer error on the same matcher-derived checkpoints. H0: the existing refinement either does not change coordinates, or the changes do not improve held-out geometric consistency.
decision_rule: Refinement is treated as improving held-out geometric consistency only if B changes at least one coordinate AND the same held-out checkpoint RMSE is strictly lower for B than for A. Coordinate change alone is not accuracy.

held_constant: representation routing and intensity percentile stretch
coordinate mapping back to original image pixels
control-point selection grid_bins 8, max 1 point per cell
registration model and the 16,777,216-pixel output cap

matching_view.coordinate_mapping: x_original = x_matching * stride; y_original = y_matching * stride

evaluation.rmse: sqrt(mean(stored inlier verification residuals^2)); not independent accuracy

held_out_validation.design: k-fold split of verified correspondences; transform refitted on the complement of each fold and scored on the fold itself
held_out_validation.note: held-out transfer error is not independent accuracy; there is no surveyed lunar control

generate_representation.coordinate_mapping: x_original = x_matching * stride; y_original = y_matching * stride

select_control_points.note: spatial grid 8x8, max 1 per cell; all 11 points are the pre-refinement coordinates passed to both variants

matcher_held_out_validation.design: k-fold split of verified correspondences; transform refitted on the complement of each fold and scored on the fold itself
matcher_held_out_validation.units: original image pixels (reference frame transfer error)
matcher_held_out_validation.why_not_independent_accuracy: held-out points are matcher-derived and were selected by the same RANSAC consensus as the fitting points, so their errors are correlated with the fit; no surveyed lunar control exists
matcher_held_out_validation.note: This split is on verified correspondences and does not use refined coordinates. It is the EXP-001 SIFT control on this pair, identical for A and B. It is not independent accuracy.

refine_points.limitation: Variant A is the identity passthrough ablation. Zero coordinates changed by definition. INDETERMINATE means no refinement was applied; this is the intended control, not a failure.

zncc_acceptance.note: ZNCC acceptance is not computed for identity_passthrough; no template comparison is performed.

evaluate.rmse_meaning: RMSE of stored verification inlier residuals on points used to fit the transform; this is a fit diagnostic, not accuracy

control_point_held_out.note: Variant A uses unrefined coordinates (same as EXP-001 pre-refinement). k-fold on 11 control points with 4-point minimum: 11 < 5 (min_required = model_min_samples + 1), so k-fold is possible. EXP-001 SIFT held-out on 25 verified inliers (not just control points) gives RMSE = 1.9044 px. Control-point subset k-fold was not run in EXP-001 and requires a live run.

unselected_verified_checkpoints.note: 14 verified inliers (25 total - 11 control points) could serve as unselected checkpoints. These were not scored in EXP-001 and require a live run.

refine_points.limitation: EXP-001 stores the count of changed coordinates (2) and the post-refinement coordinates but not the pre-refinement coordinates of the changed points, so mean and max displacement cannot be computed from this record. A live EXP-005 run is required for displacement magnitudes.

zncc_acceptance.note: Inferred from EXP-001 coordinates_changed_count=2 out of 11 input points. The 9 rejected points were accepted by the frozen refine_points() but their parabolic peaks either fell below min_peak_zncc=0.25 or the valid-pixel fraction was below 0.75, so their coordinates were not updated. Exact ZNCC values per point require a live run.

evaluate.rmse_meaning: RMSE of stored verification inlier residuals on points used to fit the transform; this is a fit diagnostic, not accuracy; this RMSE is NOT recomputed after refinement and therefore does not measure refinement accuracy

control_point_held_out.note: k-fold on 11 refined control points requires a live run; not in EXP-001 record.

unselected_verified_checkpoints.note: 14 unselected verified inliers could be scored against the transform fitted on 11 refined control points. This was not computed in EXP-001 and requires a live run.

held_out_validation_from_exp001.design: k-fold split of all 25 verified correspondences (not just the 11 control points). This is the EXP-001 held-out split with zncc_parabolic_baseline in the pipeline.
held_out_validation_from_exp001.units: original image pixels (reference frame transfer error)
held_out_validation_from_exp001.note: This held-out split is on all verified correspondences before control-point grid selection. It is the same split as the matcher_held_out_validation above and applies equally to both A and B because control points were selected from the same verified set before any refinement differentiation occurred in this re-analysis.

interpretation.decision_rule: Refinement is treated as improving held-out geometric consistency only if B changes at least one coordinate AND the same held-out checkpoint RMSE is strictly lower for B than for A.

partial_findings_from_exp001.reason_not_comparable: EXP-001 k-fold ran on all 25 verified inliers equally for all matchers; per-variant unrefined vs refined held-out scoring requires a live EXP-005 run

limitations: Independent accuracy is NOT VALIDATED. There is no surveyed lunar control.
Matcher-derived held-out points are not ground truth.
evaluate().rmse is stored verification-inlier residual RMSE and does not recompute residuals after refinement.
ZNCC + parabolic is a same-modality software baseline, not a multimodal OHRC/LROC solution.
Overlap is not recomputed from the products. The manifest declares overlap_status=verified from NASA PDS ODE footprints.
Full-raster registration remains blocked by the existing 16,777,216-pixel cap.
No refinement algorithm, matcher, SIFT, representation, RANSAC, or registration change was introduced.

The held-out RMSE for A vs B cannot be compared from this record. The unselected-checkpoint scorer (14 remaining inliers) and control-point k-fold scorer require a live EXP-005 run with D:\SIH mounted.
Displacement magnitude (mean and max pixels) is not stored in EXP-001. Only the count of changed coordinates (2/11) is known from this record.
9/11 ZNCC refinement attempts were rejected (acceptance rate 18.2%). The reason per point (below min_peak_zncc threshold vs below min_valid_pixel_fraction) is not recoverable from EXP-001 data.
D:\SIH was not mounted during this session. Run python scripts/run_exp005.py with the drive mounted to obtain a complete live record.

reproducibility.note: Reproducibility values from EXP-001 run. EXP-005 was not independently executed in this session.
